title: RGenEDA 0.99.0
text: Renumbered 0.99.0 Bioconductor submission (continues 2.1.0). Added .geneda() build geneda object SummarizedExperiment, DESeqDataSet, DESeqTransform, carrying counts, normalized values, colData, optional DEG tables. Normalized values can come assay, transformed object, matrix, computed DESeq2 vst log2 CPM. Added biocViews, URL, BugReports fields DESCRIPTION. Removed LazyData; load example data data(Snail1KO). Added runnable examples exported functions using bundled Snail1KO data. Documented return values FindHVDEGs() show() method. Replaced sapply() vapply() 1:n seq_len(). Vignette now uses accessors instead @ slot access reports sessionInfo(). Restyled code Bioconductor style (4-space indents, 80-character lines).

title: RGenEDA 2.1.0
text: Fixed cosmetics printing statements. Minor bug fixes PCA functions accessors.

title: RGenEDA 2.0.2
text: Fixed bug RunPCA() PCs beyond 10 named NA. Fixed bug PlotScree() PCs beyond 10 shown NA.

title: RGenEDA 2.0.1
text: Added PlotScree(). PCA utilities now generate PCs dynamically PC10. Renamed DimReduction$Loadings DimReduction$Scores. Added scree plot vignette.

title: RGenEDA 2.0.0
text: Added assay argument SetDEGs(), PlotMA(), FilterDEGs() (saveAssay). Added PlotVolcano(), FindHVDEGs(), GenSave(). Renamed eigencorr, ordcorr, distanceHeatmap PlotEigenCorr(), PlotOrdCorr(), PlotDistances(). Replaced pasilla demo Snail1 KO dataset (Maturi et al., 2018).

title: RGenEDA 1.0.2
text: Fixed example blocks roxygen headers. Addressed R CMD check errors, warnings, notes.

title: RGenEDA 1.0.1
text: heatmaps now use pheatmap. Fixed top-gene-loading bug PlotEigenHeatmap(). Added optional DEGs slot interface DESeq2. Added MA plot functionality.

title: RGenEDA 1.0.0
text: Introduced S4 geneda object. Added methods HVG calculation PCA storage. Added PCA, HVG variance, eigenvector plots. Eigencorrelation plots now use top HVGs HVG selection/PCA. Added unit tests pasilla vignette.
